text:
maya: Quick follow-up from the PM yesterday — root cause was the canary path not emitting the error-rate metric, so auto-rollback never fired. Need owners and timelines for remediation.
kevin: Confirmed. canary HTTP client skips the middleware that emits errors when sampling is enabled. Ops logs show no rollback event.
ops-bot: [deploy] canary-2025-05-01: rollback not triggered (no metric breach logged)
samir: Proposed actions:
1) instrument error-rate in canary client (owner: samir, est 2d)
2) add a rollback test harness + alert rule that triggers simulated breaches (owner: kevin, est 1w)
3) tighten feature-flag scoping + blast-radius quotas (owner: anna, est 2w)
anna: ack. I'll draft the flag scoping RFC and include explicit quota examples and env gating.
kevin: For the harness we should run a staged synthetic traffic job in staging and include a simulateRollback flag. config sketch:
```
# rollback sim config
simulate_rollback: true
error_rate_threshold: 0.05
sample_window: 30s
```
maya: Who will own the postmortem action tracker? We need recurring check-ins (biweekly) for 4 checkpoints.
leo: I'll take tracker ownership and run the biweekly until metrics are stable. First check-in: Fri 2025-05-09.
samir: Also recommend adding an explicit "canary-exit" metric (reason codes: rollback, promote, manual-stop) to the release dashboard.
maya: Good call. Consolidating action items below and adding deadlines.
- samir: instrument canary error-rate and add unit/integ tests (due 2025-05-03)
- kevin: implement rollback test harness, alert rule, and dashboard panels (due 2025-05-10)
- anna: feature-flag scoping RFC + quota + gating rules (due 2025-05-15)
- leo: maintain postmortem tracker + run biweekly check-ins (first: 2025-05-09)
kevin: please also add a panel for "rollback latency" (breach -> action) so we can quantify reaction time.
maya: added to kevin's card. I'll update the postmortem doc and tag eng-sre for review. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder created: postmortem-actions #12345 assigned to leo
anna: thanks — I'll loop in security for flag KMS/access restrictions and policy review.
maya: closing loop here — we'll revisit after two check-ins and mark any follow-ups as new tickets.
